name: The Queen of Dale
oracle_text: Whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, you recruit. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, you recruit. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.)

needs.what: a per-player once-each-turn restriction on a trigger -- say `max_per_turn_per_player: 1` on TriggerSpec (src/automtg/cards/schema.py:276, beside the existing `max_per_turn`), counted in `triggers._queue` (src/automtg/engine/triggers.py:1398) under a key of `(obj.oid, ability.index, actor_pid)` instead of `(obj.oid, ability.index)`, where `actor_pid` is the seat the event was about -- the same seat `_actor` already computes for the `controller: "opponent"` check and that `bindings["event_player"]` exposes. With that one key this card is a single `spell_cast` trigger: `{"event": "spell_cast", "controller": "opponent", "filter": {"not_types": ["Creature"]}, "max_per_turn_per_player": 1}`. It is the clause the whole Rhystic/tax family is printed with, and docs/unsupported-cards.md already tracks it under this same slug for Esper Sentinel, whose trigger line is word-for-word identical to this one.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `max_per_turn` is the nearest thing in `trigger_keys` and it is documented as a *per-permanent* cap: `triggers._queue` keys `state.triggers_this_turn` by `(obj.oid, ability.index)` (src/automtg/engine/triggers.py:1398-1404), so `max_per_turn: 1` says "the first noncreature spell **any** opponent casts each turn". In a duel that happens to coincide with the printed card; at a pod -- where a two-mana legendary Commander creature is actually played -- it silently drops the recruit for every opponent after the first. That is an approximation, not the line. The three near substitutes each fail differently and are all already recorded as dead ends: (1) `nth`, the ordinal filter that would say "their first", is refused by the loader on anything but a draw trigger (carddef.py:441 documents it as `draw` only) because only `draw_cards` stamps an ordinal on its event -- `game._cast` fires SPELL_CAST with player/source/oid/sid/card/kicked and no ordinal at all. (2) A trigger `condition` of `{"cmp": [{"spells_cast_this_turn": {"binding": "event_player"}}, ...]}` counts the wrong things twice over: `TurnLedger.spells_cast` is a flat per-player tally of **all** spells with no type filter, so an opponent who casts a creature and then an artifact is already at 2 and never recruits, while the printed card recruits off that artifact; and 603.4 re-asks an intervening-if at resolution, by which point the tally has moved again. (3) `set_turn_flag`/`has_turn_flag` write and read `TurnLedger.object_flags` keyed by the ability's own `ctx.source_oid` (src/automtg/engine/effects/conditions.py:220) -- by the Queen, not by the caster -- so it reproduces `max_per_turn: 1` exactly. Nothing in `trigger_keys`, `condition_keys` or `value_keys` can ask "is this the first noncreature spell **this** player has cast this turn".

notes: Only the trigger's rate clause is missing; `recruit`'s whole reminder text is already sayable and needs no new capability. The effects half would be, verbatim: `[{"op": "draw", "player": "you", "amount": {"const": 1}}, {"op": "discard", "player": "you", "amount": {"const": 1}, "as": "pitched"}, {"op": "if", "condition": {"exists": {"binding": "pitched", "not_types": ["Land"]}}, "then": [{"op": "create_token", "token": "human_soldier_1_1_w", "amount": {"const": 1}}]}]` -- the `as`-binding-plus-`exists` shape Mog, Moogle Warrior already ships, and `human_soldier_1_1_w` ("1/1 white Human Soldier creature") is in the token pool, so this is NOT a token gap. Once `max_per_turn_per_player` exists the card is one triggered ability on a 2/1 Legendary Creature -- Human Noble for {1}{W} and nothing else, and it closes this slug jointly with Esper Sentinel. Its expectation would then be the honest weak one, `{"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}`: the sandbox casts the card and stops, so no opponent ever casts a spell after it and the trigger cannot be made to fire.
